title: The Assyrians Conquer Samaria
description: The Assyrian king Shalmaneser besieges Samaria during the reign of King Hosea, and after three years the city falls. The Israelites are taken into exile in Assyria and settled in Halah, by the Habor River in Gozan, and in the cities of Media. This happens because the people have broken the Lord's covenant and have not listened to his voice.
